description: Bean qou-prjo.  Answers the question PR #4849 sec 2.3 left open: is the transverse NA-Stokes pairing Omega_2 gauge-covariant under the connection transformation law of the germ dq = q (d_q rho) rho^-1?  IT IS NOT.  Formalize-first: QOU/MassTheory/GermConnectionGaugeCovariance.lean (sorry-free, generic Ring, #print axioms clean on all 48 declarations) proves the germ is a 1-cocycle, proves the connection law, proves covariance holds IFF a defect vanishes, exhibits a concrete triple where it does not, proves the pairing is covariant GIVEN covariant inputs (so all failure sits in F_q), and proves the covariant second-order object -- the bracket cup square -- is EXACTLY a coboundary with explicit primitive beta = D.alpha, hence zero in H^2.  This probe verifies all of it against the actual Hecke germ: exactly over Q(q) in the 2-dim rep (connection law, nonzero defect, cup-square identity, gauge-invariance of tr alpha), and numerically on the corpus 4He atom word atom_braid_word_3A(2,2) in H_12(q) in TWO gauges -- diag(1,q,...,q^(d-1)) on Hoefsmit seminormal (covariance defect measured directly) and the reduced-Burau realization of the SAME lambda=(11,1) representation (compared via the conjugation-INVARIANT tr(Omega^k), so the comparison needs no intertwiner and is readout-independent).  Both show non-covariance.  Consequence: Omega_2 has no basis-independent value, so the germ-observer-pair selection question of #4849 is VOID rather than open.  Also retro-checks #4848: its Omega_2 = 0 on sigma_1^3 is itself gauge-dependent -- correct within a q-INDEPENDENT change of basis, not under the full connection freedom.  No AME quantity, no g_2, no binding number appears anywhere; free_parameters = 0; nothing wired; bean OPEN.

parameters.algebra: H_3(q) 2-dim rep (symbolic, exact Q(q)); H_12(q) lambda=(11,1) and (10,1,1) (numeric)
parameters.gauges_compared: (a) Hoefsmit seminormal vs diag(1,q,...,q^(d-1)) rescaling; (b) Hoefsmit seminormal lambda=(11,1) vs reduced Burau at t=q^-2 scaled by q (the #4798/#4848 gauge)
parameters.germ_convention: logarithmic q-derivative q*(d_q rho)*rho^-1, analytic entry derivatives; rho^-1 = rho - h from the Hecke relation
parameters.transport_convention: Yekutieli ordered partial product along the braid word
parameters.readout: conjugation-invariant tr(Omega^k) for the cross-gauge comparison; Ad(B)^-1 Omega' - Omega for the explicitly-known gauge

caveats: SCOPE-(b), STRUCTURAL EXCLUSION, for the claim 'Omega_2 (equivalently F_q) has a basis-independent value'.  Cited invariant: the germ is the right logarithmic derivative of a q-family, hence a 1-COCYCLE, defined only up to the coboundary (1 - Ad u)Theta; the induced defect on [dq_i, dq_j] is nonzero (Lean gaugeDefect_ne_zero; exhibited exactly here in A3), and the conjugation-invariant tr(Omega^k) demonstrably differ between two realizations of the SAME representation.  This is a proved algebraic obstruction, not a failed search.

SCOPE-(a) for the residual question 'does SOME nonzero covariant functional of the germ exist'.  What is PROVED is that the canonical covariant second-order object (the bracket cup square) is identically a coboundary, and that the invariant linear functional tr alpha(w) = q d_q log det rho(w) sees only the abelianisation (writhe/framing, already walled).  A full classification of gauge-invariant functionals of [alpha] in H^1 is NOT attempted and stays open.

RETRO-NARROWING OF #4848 (not a refutation).  Its algebra is correct and its quantification -- every intersection form J, every handle-exponent assignment -- is honoured.  But it did not range over q-DEPENDENT changes of representation basis, and under those the sigma_1^3 pairing is NONZERO (A4).  So #4848's scope-(b) should be read as conditional on a fixed germ trivialisation.  #4849 sec 2.3's parenthetical 'the answer there was 0 in every gauge' is correspondingly too strong.

sorry-free != derived.  Nothing here derives a Delta_lambda, a binding energy, or a magnitude.  The bean's >= 3-body magnitude gate is untouched and OPEN.  This closes a route by showing its observable does not exist, which is a narrower and more fundamental statement than 'the value was not selected'.

The A >= 3 germ is q-DEPENDENT (#4849 sec 2.2), so the q0 pin is material and is recorded.  q0 = experimental proton anchor per the owner directive of 2026-08-07; no muon-serving cache is touched anywhere in this probe.

Arithmetic: exact sympy over Q(q) in part A; float64 in part B, where the verdict is a 0-vs-O(1) question (covariance defect) and a relative-difference-of-invariants question at the 1e-1..1e0 level, not a 1-ppQ question.  Representation certification residuals are reported.
q0AnchorReason: recovered by transcription from this witness's own payload (key(s): data.q0_experimental_proton_anchor, parameters.q0_experimental_proton_anchor). No producer was re-run and no number changed; the pin was always recorded, under a non-canonical key.
